notes: Slice 18 contains no Blam engine code at all. It is the tail of the statically linked D3DX9 blob (HLSL compiler/shader assembler, then D3DX9's bundled libjpeg/zlib/libpng image codecs and 3DNow! SIMD math), then linker delay-load thunks, then the start of the GameSpy SDK (natneg, qr2/master server, gt2, MD5, serverbrowsing). The libjpeg/zlib/3DNow blocks are labelled lib:other rather than lib:d3dx because they are distinct third-party libraries even though they ship inside d3dx9.lib; if the project prefers attributing the whole static blob to D3DX, 0x606360-0x61310f should be lib:d3dx instead. Address gaps (0x6069d0->0x6070c0, 0x60e6ff->0x610f50) are unanalysed code/data, not module boundaries.
